create_LightplaneRenderer: create a LightplaneRenderer module with configurable MLP layers, grid channels, and sample count for 3D rendering
run_forward_rendering: run the LightplaneRenderer forward pass with Rays and feature grid to render images with alpha masks
eval_decoder_at_points: evaluate the decoder MLP at given 3D points using feature grid and ray encoding to get opacity and color
calculate_scaffold: calculate a voxel scaffold by sampling the feature grid and pruning points below an opacity threshold
eval_opacity_at_points: evaluate opacity values at given 3D points using the feature grid and decoder parameters
